scope: Bubble-only sizing, fractional-DPI dragging and companion resource use

claims.bubbleSizing: Text, padding and width follow the saved bubble multiplier
claims.dragging: Window dimensions remain stable during continuous drag; repeated events at a stationary cursor do not accumulate movement
claims.dpiChange: A display scale-factor event replaces native surfaces and discards old pointer captures
claims.performance: Shared cursor sampling, cached hit geometry and a 32 MiB decoded-frame budget; no CPU percentage reduction claimed

limits: Native scaling checks use isolated runtime scale settings and a simulated display-metrics event; Windows system settings are unchanged
The frame budget excludes in-flight decoding and permits the currently requested and newest frame to remain available for painting
This change does not publish a new npm version
